You may start an IC conflict with another player as long as it does not prevent them from doing their job. Although you are allowed to escalate conflicts, you may face administrative action if the situation leads to violence and you had poor IC justification for provoking it.
Killing a crew member is an extreme response that requires serious justification, as shown, for example, by the precedents in [textlink="Rule 2" link="PER2"] or [textlink="Rule 4" link="PER4"].
When reasonable, the side left standing must treat critically wounded characters or take them to Medbay; taking unnecessary action against a wounded player may expose you to retaliation. If you are incapacitated in a fight and then treated, or if the conflict is interrupted in another meaningful way, you are expected to have an IC reason beyond "wounded pride" before resuming it.
